result.reason: The redline adds the preferred Licensor indemnity triggers, but it does not reach the playbook position. It leaves Licensee’s indemnity broadly covering all license use, business conduct, and contractual breaches rather than limiting it to Licensee-provided content and breach of law, and it omits notice, control-of-defense, and cooperation procedures. It also fails the fallback because there are no IP exclusions or procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and the indemnity remains subject to the one-half-fees liability cap rather than a 3× annual-fees super-cap. Further, the exclusion carveout applies only to indemnification obligations “under Article XII,” while the new Licensor indemnity is placed after Article XIII, creating ambiguity as to whether the carveout applies. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
